question: Can March scaledIFBFat serve as a temporally prior physiological-readiness variable in the same mule-deer animal-years that show signed migration feedback?

primary_temporal_gate.rule: retain only animal-years with non-missing scaledIFBFat and DOY.migration.start strictly after the last day of March
primary_temporal_gate.rationale: the source paper states nutritional condition is % scaled IFBFat in March but the public CSV lacks exact capture date; starts after March 31 guarantee that any March measurement preceded migration start

evidence_updates.if_safe_rows_exist: mule deer timer evidence may move from T0 to T3_CANDIDATE because a physiological state was measured before the event and the source GLMM reports a weak start-timing association; hybrid may move to H1_CANDIDATE because D2 signed feedback is already present in the same system
evidence_updates.H2_requirement: requires a preregistered IFBFat/readiness × signed-phase interaction on downstream actuator response; coexistence of IFBFat and D2 is insufficient

forbidden: treat March IFBFat as pre-departure when the migration start occurred during or before March without exact capture date
claim nutritional condition is a molecular clock
claim H2 readiness-gated feedback from the source paper's separate main effects
retune frozen GEB V2 or preregistered results
